'''Stanislav Vladimirovich Drobyshevsky''' ({{langx|ru|Станислав Владимирович Дробышевский}}; born 2 July 1978) is a Russian [[Anthropology|anthropologist]] and [[Popular science|science popularizer]]. He is a [[Candidate of Sciences]] and works at the Anthropology department of the [[MSU Faculty of Biology|Faculty of Biology]] of [[Moscow State University]]. He is a [[contributing editor|scientific editor]] of the popular science portal ''[[Antropogenez.ru]]''. His body of work includes [[monograph]]s, university textbooks, and popular science books. He is a [[vlog]]ger and [[YouTube]]r. He also frequently appears in other Russian popular science channels.

== Education ==
He studied at the [[MSU Faculty of Biology]] as an undergraduate in 1995-2000, and as a graduate student in 2000-2004. After getting a Candidate's degree in 2004, he has been working at the Anthropology Department of that faculty.<ref name="antropogenez_author">{{cite web |url= http://antropogenez.ru/author/3/ |title= Stanislav Drobyshevsky |last= |first= |date= |website= Antropogenez.ru |publisher= |access-date= |quote=}}</ref>

He created university courses in [[human evolution]], [[anthropology]], [[archaeology]], and [[Historical race concepts|race science]].<ref>[http://www.ido.rudn.ru/psychology/anthropology/glossary.html Глоссарий] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150422144423/http://www.ido.rudn.ru/psychology/anthropology/glossary.html |date=2015-04-22 }} //Богатенков Д. В., Дробышевский С. В. Антропология</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://istina.msu.ru/profile/Drobyshevsky/ |title= Stanislav Drobyshevsky |last= |first= |date= |website=ISTINA |publisher=[[Moscow State University|MSU]] |access-date= |quote=}}</ref>

== Science communication ==

=== Non-missing link ===
In addition to his editorial activities, Drobyshevsky is actively working on his own project ''Non-missing Link''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Non-missing Link |url=http://antropogenez.ru/zveno/|last=Drobyshevsky|first=Stanislav|date=|website=Antropogenez.ru|publisher=|quote=|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101027091513/http://antropogenez.ru/zveno/|archive-date=2010-10-27|access-date=2014-04-21}}</ref> It is a series of articles where he discusses his views of the problems and methods of anthropology. The articles are illustrated by a series of short videos in which Drobyshevsky talks about the scientific method of studying human nature. For example, using copies of fossil skulls and skeletons, he discusses what specific parts of the skeleton are called, what the limits are of their variability within a species, which pathologies they can have, what functions they perform, which regions of the brain are responsible for them, how they are different or similar in humans and apes, and how they evolved.

In 2017, the series of articles was published as a two-volume book ''Non-missing link''.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://antropogenez.ru/book/22/ |title= Non-missing link. Vol 1. Apes and everyone else |last=Drobyshevsky |first=Stanislav |date= |website= Antropogenez.ru |publisher= |access-date= |quote=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://antropogenez.ru/book/23/ |title= Non-missing link. Vol 2. Humans |last=Drobyshevsky |first=Stanislav |date= |website= Antropogenez.ru |publisher= |access-date= |quote=}}</ref>

=== In media ===
Drobyshevsky frequently appears on radio and television. Since March 15, 2021, he has been hosting ''Homo Sapiens'' program on [[RTVI]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://rtvi.com/broadcast/drobyshevskiy/ |title= Homo Sapiens |last= Drobyshevsky |first= Stanislav |date=  |website=  |publisher= [[RTVI]] |access-date= |quote= |archive-date= 2021-04-25 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20210425125513/https://rtvi.com/broadcast/drobyshevskiy/ |url-status= dead }}</ref>

== Awards ==
Drobyshevsky was awarded a prize ''For loyalty to science'' by [[Ministry of Education and Science (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Education and Science]] as ''Popularizer of the year'' 2017.<ref name=chrdk>{{cite web
|url = https://chrdk.ru/news/nazvany-imena-laureatov-premii-za-vernost-nauke-2017
|title = Names of the winners of the award For loyalty to science - 2017
|date = 2018-02-06
|accessdate = 2018-03-30}}</ref>
